## Individual investors are suddenly more optimistic, but still below the historic average, AAII says

More mom and pop investors are optimistic about the outlook for stocks over the coming six months, but the number is still below the historic average for the third time in four weeks, according to the latest weekly poll by the American Association of Individual Investors.
